這個吸收與同化過程完全依賴植物自身的根毛細胞進行主動運輸，過程中絕對不需要任何微生物或細菌的協助。
This absorption and assimilation process completely relies on the active transport of the plant's own root hair cells and absolutely requires no assistance from microorganisms or bacteria.
相反，程序(1)反硝化作用、(2)固氮作用、(6)腐化作用及(7)硝化作用，每一環節都必須依賴特定的泥土細菌作為生化催化劑才能完成。
Conversely, process (1) denitrification, (2) nitrogen fixation, (6) putrefaction, and (7) nitrification each must rely on specific soil bacteria as biochemical catalysts to be completed.

📌 考試提醒
必須清晰區分氮循環中哪些步驟是細菌專屬的生化反應，哪些是動植物自身的日常代謝或吸收。
One must clearly distinguish which steps in the nitrogen cycle are exclusive biochemical reactions of bacteria, and which are the daily metabolism or absorption of plants and animals themselves.
常見錯誤：將植物吸取無機鹽的自然吸收機制，錯誤歸類為需要細菌加工的硝化或固氮程序。
Common trap：Mistakenly categorizing the natural absorption mechanism of plants taking up inorganic salts as nitrification or nitrogen fixation processes that require bacterial processing.

The mutualistic symbiosis between leguminous plants and nitrogen-fixing bacteria is a classic, frequently tested example in the nitrogen cycle; bacteria provide nitrogenous fertilizer, and plants provide carbohydrates in return.

Storing vegetables in a low-temperature environment of 4°C works primarily by depriving molecular kinetic energy, plummeting the activity of food-spoiling microorganisms to freezing point (1 is correct).

Although low temperatures objectively reduce water evaporation, vegetables retaining water is actually more conducive to bacterial reproduction; therefore, "reducing evaporation" is absolutely not the preservation and anti-spoilage reason why they can be stored longer (3 is incorrect).

The core goals of food preservation are only two: eliminating microorganisms (e.g., high heat), or hindering microbial reproduction and enzyme operation (e.g., low temperature, dehydration, high salt curing).
常見錯誤：未有深入分析選項因果，直覺以為「減少水分蒸發」能令蔬菜看起來新鮮，便等同於防止微生物腐壞。

As a historically famous insecticide, DDT's fatal flaw is that it is a non-biodegradable substance.
由於自然界的微生物無法將其分解，加上它具有脂溶性，它會無限期殘留在環境中，並在食物鏈中層層遞進累積（生物累積作用）。

"Bioaccumulation" specifically refers to toxins accumulating in a single organism over time; "Biomagnification" refers to toxin concentration increasing upwards along a food chain.
常見錯誤：僅僅記得DDT有毒，卻不明白它之所以成為全球禁藥的決定性原因，是它無法被自然生態系統排解及會沿食物鏈倍增。
Common trap：Only remembering that DDT is toxic, but failing to understand that the decisive reason it became a globally banned drug is its inability to be naturally cleared by ecosystems and its exponential increase along food chains.

選項A在物理機制的因果關係上完全顛倒了，因此敘述極不正確。
Option A has the cause-and-effect relationship of the physical mechanism completely reversed, thus the statement is highly incorrect.
真實情況是：溫室氣體（如二氧化碳）增加導致了「溫室效應」增強（因），困住更多長波輻射，最終引發「全球空氣溫度增加」（果）。
The reality is: an increase in greenhouse gases (like carbon dioxide) causes an enhanced "greenhouse effect" (cause), trapping more long-wave radiation, which ultimately triggers an "increase in global air temperature" (effect).
其餘選項中，懸浮粒子燻黑建築、含鉛廢氣損害神經、二氧化硫造成酸雨損害農作物，皆為無可爭議的空氣污染後果。
Among the rest, suspended particulates blackening buildings, lead-containing exhaust damaging nerves, and sulfur dioxide causing acid rain to damage crops are all indisputable consequences of air pollution.

📌 考試提醒
溫室效應（Greenhouse effect）本身是一個自然保溫現象，只有當其「人為增強」時，才會導致全球暖化的嚴重災難。
The greenhouse effect itself is a natural insulating phenomenon; it is only when it is "anthropogenically enhanced" that it leads to the severe disaster of global warming.
常見錯誤：粗心大意未看清楚選項中「導致」一詞的方向性，將溫室效應的「結果」誤認為「起因」。
Common trap：Being careless and failing to see the directional nature of the word "leads to" in the option, mistaking the "consequence" of the greenhouse effect for its "cause".

當農業肥料流失或未處理的污水排入海域，會為水體帶來異常高濃度的硝酸鹽（氮源）及磷酸鹽，此過程稱為富營養化（Eutrophication）。
When agricultural fertilizer runoff or untreated sewage is discharged into marine waters, it brings abnormally high concentrations of nitrates (nitrogen source) and phosphates to the water body, a process called eutrophication.
這些過剩的營養鹽猶如為海面施了超級大肥，直接觸發浮游藻類（Algae）以爆炸性的速度增殖，大面積覆蓋海面形成紅潮。

選項C錯誤，缺氧並非紅潮的成因，而是紅潮末期大量死藻被需氧細菌分解時，過度消耗水中氧氣所造成的致死「後果」。
Option C is incorrect; oxygen depletion is not the cause of a red tide, but rather the lethal "consequence" caused when excessive oxygen is consumed by aerobic bacteria decomposing massive amounts of dead algae at the end of a red tide.

📌 考試提醒
富營養化引發連鎖災難的時序：無機養分激增 → 藻類異常爆發（紅潮） → 藻類大批死亡 → 細菌瘋狂分解死藻 → 耗盡水中溶氧 → 魚類窒息死亡。
The chronological sequence of the chain disaster triggered by eutrophication: surge in inorganic nutrients -> abnormal algal bloom (red tide) -> mass death of algae -> bacteria frantically decomposing dead algae -> depletion of dissolved oxygen -> fish asphyxiation.
常見錯誤：倒果為因，將最終導致海洋生物群死群傷的「缺氧」現象，錯誤判定為引發藻類爆發的初始動力。
Common trap：Reversing cause and effect, mistakenly identifying the "oxygen depletion" phenomenon that ultimately leads to mass casualties of marine life as the initial driving force that triggered the algal bloom.
